item.title: Florida bill would let high school coaches spend $15K to help student athletes
item.description: The bill, inspired by former NFL QB Teddy Bridgewater, passed unanimously in the state Senate this week. It allows coaches to support athletes with their own money but also includes guardrails.

item.title: FSU's National MagLab inspires future scientists during annual open house event Saturday
item.description: The National High Magnetic Field Laboratory welcomed nearly 8,000 visitors to explore cutting-edge scientific equipment usually reserved for researchers.

item.title: Men's mental health event in Tallahassee offers resources, support, and community Sunday
item.description: A mental health event in Tallahassee helped men open up, process their emotions, and take action for themselves and their communities.
